title: Measurement of Superoxide Levels in Muscle Fillets
author: Sam Towarnicki
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ufuetnw

steps.title: Prepare Muscle Fillets
steps.instruction: Dissect larvae in PBS to produce muscle fillets.

steps.title: Incubate Fillets with H2DCFDA
steps.instruction: Incubate the fillets in 20 mM 2',7'-dichlorodihydrofluorescein diacetate (H2DCFDA) for 30 minutes at 23°C.

steps.title: Wash and Fix Fillets
steps.instruction: Wash the fillets twice in PBS and fix them in 2% paraformaldehyde for 10 minutes at 23°C.

steps.title: Image Fillets
steps.instruction: Mount the fillets on glass slides and image them using confocal laser scanning microscopy at 495/520 nm (Excitation/Emission).

steps.title: Measure Pixel Intensity
steps.instruction: Measure pixel intensity using ImageJ (https://imagej.nih.gov/ij/) with the nikon6D plugin.
